Question: 以下说法正确的是____
Options:
A. 在const成员函数中不可以使用this指针；
B. 在static成员函数中不可以使用this 指针；
C. 抽象类的成员函数都是纯虚函数；
D. 抽象类的派生类必须实现抽象类中的纯虚函数。

Need choose correct. C++ semantics.
A: const member function can use this pointer, it is const pointer to const object: const MyClass* this. Can call const member functions, access members read-only. So A false.
B: static member function doesn't have this pointer, cannot use this. True.
C: Abstract class has at least one pure virtual function, not all member functions pure virtual. False.
D: A derived class of abstract class is not necessarily abstract; if it wants to be instantiable must implement all pure virtual functions. If not implements, it remains abstract. Statement "抽象类的派生类必须实现抽象类中的纯虚函数" as general? It is not mandatory for derived class; can remain abstract. So false if strict. In many exam contexts, to be non-abstract derived must implement; but wording says must, likely false. B is clear.

Need final line 答案：B.
